title: Generalized Telescope Conjecture
summary: We extend Balmer's tensor-triangular geometry to arbitrary presentably symmetric monoidal $\infty$-categories $\mathcal V$ by introducing the atomic smashing frame. This construction is functorial in $\mathcal V$, recovers the classical Balmer spectrum in the stable compactly-rigidly generated case, and yields a formulation of the telescope conjecture for arbitrary $\mathcal V$. Using dualizable and locally rigid $\infty$-categories, we identify smashing ideals with locally rigid localizations and establish recollement results for smashing frames and atomic smashing frames.
